wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-not: This revision is not marked with an abuse review tag.

wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-dis: The false positive API is not enabled on this wiki.

wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-blo: You cannot change the false positive status of a revision while you are blocked from editing.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-mar: Marks a revision as a false positive for a reviewable tag. Removes the tag and adds the false positive version of the tag. For example, providing the `mw-private-personal-info` tag will change it to the `mw-private-personal-info-false-positive` tag. Requires the ability to see the tag you are changing.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-unm: Removes the false positive marking from a revision: For example, providing the `mw-private-personal-info` tag will remove the `mw-private-personal-info-false-positive` tag and restores the `mw-private-personal-info` tag. Requires the ability to see the tag you are changing.
